يتكوفد (form IIq)
# يَتَكَوْفَدُ (yatakawfadu) /ja.ta.kaw.fa.du/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of تَكَوْفَدَ (takawfada)
# يَتَكَوْفَدَ (yatakawfada) /ja.ta.kaw.fa.da/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of تَكَوْفَدَ (takawfada)
# يَتَكَوْفَدْ (yatakawfad) /ja.ta.kaw.fad/: third-person masculine singular non-past active jussive of تَكَوْفَدَ
